effective_contract.purpose: Secondary rectifier loading and conditional thermal envelope; not a regulator stability or safety model.
effective_contract.winding_basis: Illustrative 18V at 0.25A with 10/20% resistive voltage-rise approximation. Not measurements or a transformer model; primary loss, leakage and saturation omitted.

load_basis.audio: Six OPA2134 channels at5mA/channel at datasheet25C/±15V conditions give30mA per rail. Working reserve raised from50 to70mA using pcb-measured-r/current-budget: independent10Vpeak output-load screen requires67.8881mA excluding native rail loads. The100mA expansion screen covers the conditional18Vpeak comparison98.0882mA excluding rail loads. R619/R620 are added separately by screen_cold_loads.py. Hot/startup/fault currents and achievable unclipped outputs remain unqualified.
load_basis.logic: 2/10/20mA scenario assumptions; not a verified current budget. Idle can violate L7805 minimum5mA regulation condition.
load_basis.relay: G5V-2-H1 DC12 960ohm +/-10% at23C; use12.6V/864ohm per energized coil, ignoring transistor voltage drop. Colder operation remains to qualify.

effective_contract.iq_basis: L78 8mA plus1mA line/0.5mA load variation; L79 3mA plus1mA line/0.5mA load variation. Planning screens using tabulated conditions; not universal guaranteed startup/fault limits.
effective_contract.raw_screen_basis: Intersection of L7812C/L7815C documented regulation test ranges at modest load, and L7915C range. Outside means unqualified, not an exact predicted dropout transition.
effective_contract.thermal_basis: 100C junction is engineering target;1C/W insulator/contact path and ambient are assumptions. Shared sink computation includes all four regulators; no selected heatsink or measured chassis temperature.

sources.scope: Tables2,10,15,16, minimum load and regulation ranges
